title: OPK Hub Package
description: Schema for a hub package document: every published version of one package on an OES hub, with where to fetch its manifest and bundled payload. Open Package Format (OPK), version 0.2.0.

$schema.description: Optional editor/tooling hint. Ignored by parsers.

kind.description: Identifies this document as a hub package document.

name.description: {namespace}/{package}, both kebab-case. The namespace is what a registry grants ownership of; OPK takes no position on how.

versions.description: Every version ever published, yanked ones included. Each version appears once.

version.description: SemVer for the package's content, independent of every spec version inside it. Major when an existing reference into this content would now mean something different.

digest.description: The package digest, exactly as in the version's manifest. Once published it MUST never change.

manifest.description: The version's OPK manifest (package.json). Relative to this document, or absolute.

bundle.description: The version's bundled payload. Relative to this document, or absolute.

yanked.description: A yanked version stays fetchable, so anything already using it keeps working, but is hidden from browsing and MUST NOT be chosen for a new import.

yanked_reason.description: Why the version was yanked, for display.
